crossRefs.note: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure…
All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down…
I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound…

parallels.note: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

translations.web: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
translations.bsb: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
translations.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
translations.asv: And the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, send us away into the herd of swine.
